scope: FT8 additive boundary-only recovery; FT4 live decoder unchanged. Timings from Linux Qt5 headless application; no physical CAT/audio device.
protocol: Seven real 15-second FT8 recordings, three runs. Each replay maps its RX boundary to current UTC so deferred jobs do not receive an artificial new deadline. Counts include repeated messages at distinct time/frequency hypotheses and repeated runs; they are not station counts.
